package answer

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"testing"
)

func TestValidateCodeStructureRulesRequiredVariables(t *testing.T) {
	codeStructure := json.RawMessage(`{
		"rules": {
			"required_variables": [
				{"name": "name", "type": "string"},
				{"name": "age", "type": "number"},
				{"name": "isActive", "type": "boolean"}
			]
		}
	}`)

	validResult, err := validateCodeStructureRules(codeStructure, []WorkspaceFile{{
		Path:    "main.ts",
		Content: "const name: string = 'Marat'\nconst age: number = 25\nconst isActive: boolean = true\n",
	}})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected error: %v", err)
	}
	if !validResult.Valid {
		t.Fatalf("expected valid result, got %#v", validResult.Errors)
	}

	invalidResult, err := validateCodeStructureRules(codeStructure, nil)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected error: %v", err)
	}
	if invalidResult.Valid {
		t.Fatalf("expected invalid result for empty workspace")
	}
}

func TestValidateCodeStructureRulesRequiredInterfaces(t *testing.T) {
	codeStructure := json.RawMessage(`{
		"rules": {
			"required_interfaces": [
				{
					"name": "User",
					"required_properties": [
						{"name": "id", "type": "string"},
						{"name": "email", "type": "string"}
					],
					"optional_properties": [
						{"name": "age", "type": "number"}
					]
				}
			]
		}
	}`)

	result, err := validateCodeStructureRules(codeStructure, []WorkspaceFile{{
		Path:    "main.ts",
		Content: "interface User {\n  id: string;\n  email: string;\n  age?: number;\n}\n",
	}})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected error: %v", err)
	}
	if !result.Valid {
		t.Fatalf("expected valid interface result, got %#v", result.Errors)
	}

	result, err = validateCodeStructureRules(codeStructure, []WorkspaceFile{{
		Path:    "main.ts",
		Content: "interface User {\n  id: string;\n}\n",
	}})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected error: %v", err)
	}
	if result.Valid {
		t.Fatalf("expected invalid interface result")
	}
}

func TestValidateCodeStructureRulesRequiredFunctionsAndMethods(t *testing.T) {
	codeStructure := json.RawMessage(`{
		"rules": {
			"required_methods": [{"method": "map", "used": true}],
			"required_functions": [{"name": "squareArray", "uses_array_method": "map"}]
		}
	}`)

	result, err := validateCodeStructureRules(codeStructure, []WorkspaceFile{{
		Path:    "main.js",
		Content: "const squareArray = (items) => items.map((item) => item * item)\n",
	}})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected error: %v", err)
	}
	if !result.Valid {
		t.Fatalf("expected valid function result, got %#v", result.Errors)
	}

	result, err = validateCodeStructureRules(codeStructure, []WorkspaceFile{{
		Path:    "main.js",
		Content: "const noop = () => []\n",
	}})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected error: %v", err)
	}
	if result.Valid {
		t.Fatalf("expected invalid function result")
	}
}

func TestValidateCodeStructureRulesReactExpectedComponent(t *testing.T) {
	codeStructure := json.RawMessage(`{
		"type": "react_component",
		"entry_files": ["App.jsx"],
		"expected_component": {
			"name": "App",
			"kind": "function",
			"return_tree": {
				"tag": "h1",
				"text_equals_any": ["Hello, React!"]
			}
		}
	}`)

	result, err := validateCodeStructureRules(codeStructure, []WorkspaceFile{{
		Path:    "App.jsx",
		Content: "export default function App() {\n  return <main>{/* TODO */}</main>\n}\n",
	}})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected error: %v", err)
	}
	if result.Valid {
		t.Fatalf("expected invalid react result for starter content")
	}

	result, err = validateCodeStructureRules(codeStructure, []WorkspaceFile{{
		Path:    "App.jsx",
		Content: "export default function App() {\n  return <h1>Hello, React!</h1>\n}\n",
	}})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected error: %v", err)
	}
	if !result.Valid {
		t.Fatalf("expected valid react result, got %#v", result.Errors)
	}
}

func TestValidateCodeStructureRulesPHPConstructsAndClasses(t *testing.T) {
	constructCodeStructure := json.RawMessage(`{
		"rules": {
			"required_constructs": [
				{"type": "echo", "text_equals": "Hello, World!"},
				{"type": "foreach"},
				{"type": "array_literal", "min_items": 3}
			]
		}
	}`)

	result, err := validateCodeStructureRules(constructCodeStructure, []WorkspaceFile{{
		Path:    "index.php",
		Content: "<?php\n\n// Write your solution here.\n",
	}})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected error: %v", err)
	}
	if result.Valid {
		t.Fatalf("expected invalid php starter result")
	}

	result, err = validateCodeStructureRules(constructCodeStructure, []WorkspaceFile{{
		Path: "index.php",
		Content: `<?php
$items = ["one", "two", "three"];
foreach ($items as $item) {
    echo "Hello, World!";
}`,
	}})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected error: %v", err)
	}
	if !result.Valid {
		t.Fatalf("expected valid php construct result, got %#v", result.Errors)
	}

	classCodeStructure := json.RawMessage(`{
		"rules": {
			"required_classes": [
				{
					"name": "User",
					"properties": ["name", "age"],
					"methods": [{"name": "introduce", "returns_string": true}]
				}
			]
		}
	}`)

	result, err = validateCodeStructureRules(classCodeStructure, []WorkspaceFile{{
		Path: "index.php",
		Content: `<?php
class User {
    public $name;
    public $age;

    public function introduce() {
        return "Hello";
    }
}`,
	}})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected error: %v", err)
	}
	if !result.Valid {
		t.Fatalf("expected valid php class result, got %#v", result.Errors)
	}
}

func TestValidateCodeStructureRulesPHPVariableList(t *testing.T) {
	codeStructure := json.RawMessage(`{
		"rules": {
			"required_variables": ["name", "greeting"],
			"required_constructs": [{"type": "echo"}]
		}
	}`)

	result, err := validateCodeStructureRules(codeStructure, []WorkspaceFile{{
		Path:    "index.php",
		Content: "<?php\n$name = 'Marat';\n$greeting = 'Hello';\necho $greeting . $name;\n",
	}})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected error: %v", err)
	}
	if !result.Valid {
		t.Fatalf("expected valid php variables result, got %#v", result.Errors)
	}
}

func TestUsesValidationContractV1(t *testing.T) {
	if !usesValidationContractV1(json.RawMessage(`{
		"version": 1,
		"kind": "workspace_contract",
		"stages": [{"id":"html","engine":"html.dom"}]
	}`)) {
		t.Fatalf("expected validation contract v1 to be detected")
	}

	if usesValidationContractV1(json.RawMessage(`{
		"rules": {"doctype": true}
	}`)) {
		t.Fatalf("expected legacy code structure to skip orchestrator detection")
	}
}

func TestMapOrchestratorValidationResult(t *testing.T) {
	result, rawResult, err := mapOrchestratorValidationResult(&OrchestratorValidationResult{
		ContractKind:    "workspace_contract",
		ContractVersion: 1,
		Passed:          false,
		Stages: []OrchestratorStageReport{
			{StageID: "html", Engine: "html.dom", Passed: false, Status: "failed"},
		},
		Errors: []OrchestratorValidationError{
			{
				Code:     "HTML_TAG_MISSING",
				Message:  "required h1 is missing",
				StageID:  "html",
				Engine:   "html.dom",
				File:     "index.html",
				Selector: "h1",
			},
		},
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected error: %v", err)
	}
	if result.Valid {
		t.Fatalf("expected mapped orchestrator result to be invalid")
	}
	if len(result.Errors) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("expected exactly one mapped error, got %d", len(result.Errors))
	}
	if rawResult["source"] != "validation_orchestrator" {
		t.Fatalf("expected validation orchestrator raw result source, got %#v", rawResult["source"])
	}
}

func TestValidateCodeStructureRulesHTMLDocumentRequirements(t *testing.T) {
	codeStructure := json.RawMessage(`{
		"rules": {
			"doctype": true,
			"html": {
				"required": true,
				"required_attributes": {
					"lang": ["en", "ru"]
				}
			},
			"head": {
				"required": true,
				"required_children": [
					{ "tag": "title" }
				]
			},
			"body": {
				"required": true,
				"required_children": [
					{ "tag": "h1" }
				]
			}
		}
	}`)

	result, err := validateCodeStructureRules(codeStructure, []WorkspaceFile{{
		Path: "index.html",
		Content: `<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
  <head><title>TODO</title></head>
  <body><!-- Write your solution here --></body>
</html>`,
	}})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected error: %v", err)
	}
	if result.Valid {
		t.Fatalf("expected invalid HTML result when h1 is missing")
	}

	result, err = validateCodeStructureRules(codeStructure, []WorkspaceFile{{
		Path: "index.html",
		Content: `<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
  <head><title>Home</title></head>
  <body><h1>Hello World</h1></body>
</html>`,
	}})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected error: %v", err)
	}
	if !result.Valid {
		t.Fatalf("expected valid HTML result, got %#v", result.Errors)
	}
}

func TestValidateCodeStructureRulesHTMLListAndAttributes(t *testing.T) {
	codeStructure := json.RawMessage(`{
		"rules": {
			"body": {
				"required_children": [
					{
						"tag": "h1",
						"text_contains_any": ["Shopping list", "Список покупок"]
					},
					{
						"tag": "ul",
						"min_children": 3,
						"children": [
							{ "tag": "li" }
						]
					},
					{
						"tag": "a",
						"required_attributes": ["href"]
					},
					{
						"tag": "img",
						"required_attributes": ["src", "alt"]
					}
				]
			}
		}
	}`)

	result, err := validateCodeStructureRules(codeStructure, []WorkspaceFile{{
		Path: "index.html",
		Content: `<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
  <head><title>List</title></head>
  <body>
    <h1>Shopping list</h1>
    <ul><li>Bread</li><li>Milk</li></ul>
    <a>Open</a>
    <img src="photo.png" />
  </body>
</html>`,
	}})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected error: %v", err)
	}
	if result.Valid {
		t.Fatalf("expected invalid HTML result when list size/attrs are wrong")
	}

	result, err = validateCodeStructureRules(codeStructure, []WorkspaceFile{{
		Path: "index.html",
		Content: `<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
  <head><title>List</title></head>
  <body>
    <h1>Shopping list</h1>
    <ul><li>Bread</li><li>Milk</li><li>Cheese</li></ul>
    <a href="https://example.com">Open</a>
    <img src="photo.png" alt="Photo" />
  </body>
</html>`,
	}})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected error: %v", err)
	}
	if !result.Valid {
		t.Fatalf("expected valid HTML list/attribute result, got %#v", result.Errors)
	}
}
